sources.ref: Kiwi Ears web EQ (https://equalizer.kiwiears.com): device table, 0x31B2:0x3006 "KT-1132L USB DAC"; supported device list "Kiwi Ears Belle(Type-C Version)"

meta.notes: That 0x3006 is the Belle is by elimination: it is the only device in the app's list without a named table entry, and the only unnamed KT1132L id in its table. devicePEQ groups 0x3006 with the Chorus.
